bogsten_100_10.m: Hi kid. Nice to meet you again.
r: I've finally defeated Zuul'khan and his giant mushroom. You won't have to worry about them anymore.
Not yet. The potion merchant needs some spore sample to prepare it.

bogsten_115_10.m: Now what has happened down there?
r: I met a sorcerer called Zuul'khan. He offered me something of value, so now I'll kill you.

bogsten_115_20.m: You...what? After saving me, you would turn against me?

bogsten_200_10.m: Oh, that's great news! I suppose I can get back to work with the mushrooms, then. Maybe tomorrow, after I've had time to rest.
r: How can you be so lazy?

bogsten_200_20.m: When you get to my age, maybe you'll understand that you don't need to rush through life. Now leave me to my rest.

bogsten_20_10.m: I'm sorry to have dragged you into this, kid. Take this key. It will open the way to my mushroom cave. You will certainly find what you need.

bogsten_30_10.m: Have you collected the spores already?
r: Yes. I have them with me.

bogsten_30_20.m: These spores would do. Please go and give them to Fallhaven's potion merchant.

bogsten_40_10.m: Quick, I am dying! The potion maker is the only one who could help me!

bogsten_50_10.m: I hope you have good news for me.
r: Yes, I have got a potion for you.

bogsten_50_20.m:
Finally!
[He pours down the liquid greedily]

bogsten_52_10.m: Aaah. I feel much better. That was neat. You have my everlasting thanks, kid.
r: I am glad I could help.
I'd prefer to have my 150 gold back.

bogsten_52_12.m: No, no, no. The uplifting feeling of saving a life cannot be balanced with gold.

bogsten_60_20.m: Now that I am restored again, I should go back to work.

bogsten_60_32.m: There seems to be an evil force near us. Yes, that must be it.

bogsten_60_34.m: I remember my father warned me about this kind of thing before passing away. But I was just a kid and I forgot his advice on how to deal with it.
r: Don't worry. I deal with evil every day. Whatever lurks down there, I can handle it.
How can you forget something that important! I guess I have no choice but to go.
Stupid old man. You really think I'm here to clean up your own mess!

bogsten_60_40.m: Very good. Please go into my caves and check if everything is right.
r: You're getting on my nerves now.
No way! You've bored me more than enough!

bogsten_60_52.m: Don't forget that there are hidden rooms. I gave you my necklace so that you can find them. Wear it down in the caves. Never take it off.
r: I'm curious what I will find there.

bogsten_60_54.m: There are hidden rooms. I'll give you my necklace so that you can find them. Wear it down in the caves. Never take it off.
r: I'm curious what I will find there.

bogsten_70_10.m: It took you a long time to get back here. What has happened down there?
r: I met an old sorcerer named Zuul'khan in the cave.

bogsten_70_20.m: Zuul'khan? Hmm, I think I have heard this name already.
r: He told me that your family imprisoned him using an ancient petrifying spell.

bogsten_70_30.m: A petrifying spell? But this has to be renewed every week.
r: Exactly. Thanks to your laxity, Zuul'khan got free.

bogsten_70_40.m: And why is this Zuul'khan still running around? What did you do the whole time down there? Go and finish your work!
r: Do you actually do anything with your own hands?
I don't think so. He just disappeared into the ground.

bogsten_90_30.m:
Disappeared! I hope he doesn't appear here next.
Well, as a reward for your efforts, please take this bag of mushrooms to the potion merchant in Fallhaven. I'm sure he'll prepare something good for you.

bogsten_90_40.m: Anyway. The evil force is not gone, so you'll have to go down there again.

bogsten_90_50.m: It has moved probably to another place. But that is someone else's problem.

bogsten_90_54.m: Leave now. I need to rest.

bogsten_start_0.m: Oh young kid, you look like someone nice. I don't want you to be injured because of me. I urge you to leave!

bogsten_start_1.m: No. I shouldn't be telling you. It's too dangerous.
r: I'm way stronger than I look.

bogsten_start_2.m: My family has used this place to grow mushrooms for five generations. Our mushrooms are famous from Feygard to Nor City, loved by gourmets and potion makers alike.

bogsten_start_3.m: Last month, I went to Nor City to sell an excellent batch and decided to stay a little longer.

bogsten_start_4.m: You see, my son is studying across the country to become a Shadow priest, and he is currently in the Valanyr temple of the Shadow. I had not seen him for so long, so I decided to visit him.

bogsten_start_5.m: Anyway, when I came back here, I felt something strange had happened. I couldn't tell what, but I knew evil was around as soon as I touched the door knob.
r: Dealing with evil is my favorite hobby.
I will never help a worshipper of the Shadow!

bogsten_start_6.m: When I got to my mushroom cave, I was attacked by some sort of giant living mushroom. I've been sick since then, to the point where I'm afraid I won't live long. I've locked all access to my cave to prevent anyone from being hurt.
r: You really look bad. How can I help?

bogsten_start_7.m: I know this potion maker in Fallhaven. Could you go ask him for a cure?
r: Sure. I'll go there right now.
You fool! I'm not here to run your errands!

bogsten_start_8.m: Thank you! I'll be waiting for you. Be quick!

bogsten_waitforsoup_10.m: Wise men speak because they have something to say; fools because they have to say something.

bogsten_waitforsoup_20.m: An empty vessel makes the loudest sound. So they that have the least wit are the greatest babblers.

bogsten_waitforsoup_30.m: There are two things a person should never be angry at: What they can help, and what they cannot.

bogsten_waitforsoup_40.m: How could they see anything but the shadows if they were never allowed to move their heads?

bogsten_waitforsoup_50.m: All is flux, nothing stays still.

bogsten_waitforsoup_90.m: Leave me now, kid. I'm trying to think, don't confuse me with your presence.
r: OK. I will come back when you have more time.

fungi_panic.10: I met old man Bogsten in his cabin. He was sick after encountering a giant mushroom and wanted me to go see the potion merchant in Fallhaven to get a cure.
fungi_panic.20: The potion merchant needed four spore samples to prepare the cure. I should go back to see Bogsten.
fungi_panic.30: Bogsten gave me the key to his backyard. I should go to the mushroom cave from there and collect the spore samples.
fungi_panic.40: I showed Bogsten the spores. Now I should go back to see the potion merchant.
fungi_panic.50: The potion merchant gave me the cure. I should give it to Bogsten now.
fungi_panic.60: Bogsten said evil forces in his cave were preventing him from working. He asked me to check his cave and gave me his necklace.
fungi_panic.70: I met an old sorcerer named Zuul'khan in the cave. He told me Bogsten's family imprisoned him using an ancient petrifying spell, but thanks to Bogsten's laxity, he was now free.
fungi_panic.72: He wanted me to kill Bogsten and bring him Bogsten's staff.
fungi_panic.90: I defeated Zuul'khan, but he was not dead. He disappeared into the ground.
fungi_panic.92: I told Bogsten about what happened.
fungi_panic.100: Bogsten remembered the petrifying spell. This time he would make sure that Zuul'khan cannot come back. He gave me a bag of mushrooms and told me I should take them to the potion merchant.
fungi_panic.102: Zuul'khan seems to have moved away from Bogsten's caves to another hiding place.
fungi_panic.110: The potion merchant said that these were very rare mushrooms. He prepared two "Underground Fighter" potions for me. He would sell me some more if I came back.
fungi_panic.115: Zuul'khan's offer seemed interesting. I have to go kill Bogsten.
fungi_panic.135: I decided to keep Bogsten's staff for myself, so I had to kill Zuul'khan.
fungi_panic.145: I defeated Zuul'khan, but he was not dead. He disappeared into the ground.
fungi_panic.150: I gave Bogsten's staff to Zuul'khan.
fungi_panic.155: He rewarded me with permanent immunity to Spore Infection.
fungi_panic.161: I got through the black fog.
fungi_panic.162: I got through the black fog again after a fight with Zuul'khan.
fungi_panic.164: After another fight with Zuul'khan I got through the black fog again.
fungi_panic.169: I overpowered Zuul'khan one more time, but this time the black fog wouldn't go away. Obviously I can't get past the fog that way.
fungi_panic.170: I defeated Zuul'khan one last time and the black fog was gone for good. I must find and destroy the fungi leader.
fungi_panic.200: I defeated the giant mushroom, Zuul'khan's fungi leader.
fungi_panic.210: A young girl named Lediofa emerged after my battle with the mushroom. She told me how Zuul'khan captured her as food for the mushroom. She seemed to have been poisoned just like Bogsten, so I directed her to see the Fallhaven potioner.
fungi_panic.220: I met Lediofa at the potions shop in Fallhaven. She couldn't afford to pay the potioner for a mushroom poison cure, so I gave her the gold she needed. In return, she offered her family's hospitality if I ever come to visit in Nor City.

gison_soup.10:
In a hut southwest from Fallhaven I met Alaun.
He asked me to bring him some of the delicious soup made by Gison with forest mushrooms.
Gison's house lies to the south.
gison_soup.20: I found Gison's house and should deliver the soup to Alaun while it is hot.
gison_soup.22: Gison gave me a new soup for 5 gold.
gison_soup.24: Gison gave me a new soup for 50 gold.
gison_soup.26: Gison gave me a new soup for 500 gold.
gison_soup.28: Gison gave me a new soup for 5000 gold. I should really go to Alaun now.
gison_soup.30:
Alaun received the soup.
I should take the empty bottle back to Gison.
gison_soup.35: Alaun told me that Nimael also makes soup.
gison_soup.40: Gison thanked me for bringing the empty bottle back to him.
gison_soup.50:
I spent 5555 gold on buying mushroom soup! Am I crazy? 
There is no soup left for Alaun now.
gison_soup.60: Gison insisted his soup is better than Nimael's.
gison_soup.70: Nimael insisted her soup is better than Gison's.
gison_soup.80: Gison gave me a taste of both soups.
gison_soup.90: Nimael gave me a taste of both soups.
gison_soup.100: Gison said he would talk to Nimael about selling both soups in Fallhaven.
gison_soup.110: Nimael said she would talk to Gison about selling both soups in Fallhaven.
gison_soup.120: Nimael and Gison have been successful in selling more soup in Fallhaven by cooperating and creating more recipes.
